title:
Condo owners
can buy HDB now

lines.say: If you own a condo, the government just removed a fifteen month wait.
lines.cap: if you own a condo, the government just *removed a 15 month wait*

lines.say: Before this, you sold your condo. Then waited fifteen months to buy a resale flat.
lines.cap: before this, you sold your condo. then *waited 15 months* for a resale flat

lines.say: The rule came in 2022. Cash rich owners were pushing resale prices up.
lines.cap: the rule came in 2022. *cash rich owners* were pushing resale prices up

lines.say: Now resale growth has cooled. Prices even dipped two quarters in a row.
lines.cap: now resale growth has cooled. prices *dipped two quarters in a row*

lines.say: So the government opened the tap again.
lines.cap: so the government *opened the tap again*

lines.say: More buyers can now chase the same resale flats.
lines.cap: *more buyers* can now chase the same resale flats

lines.say: But supply is coming too. Nineteen thousand five hundred flats reach MOP in 2028.
lines.cap: but supply is coming too. *19,500 flats* reach MOP in 2028

lines.say: If you owned a condo today, would you right size to HDB?
lines.cap: if you owned a condo today, *would you right size?* comment YES or NO

caption:
Condo owners no longer need to wait 15 months to buy an HDB resale flat. 🏠

The rule came in 2022 to cool resale prices. Now that prices have cooled, the government has opened the tap again.

If you owned a condo today, would you right size to HDB? Comment YES or NO 👇
